summary: The first rank-16 launch stopped before GPU work because the safety check correctly refused to overwrite the previously installed rank-32 attention overlay with different content.
evidence: The launcher raised FileExistsError on the differing managed overlay before torchrun started.
No model was loaded, no GPU work ran, and no checkpoint exists.
lessons: Version third-party overlay filenames when their registered experiment implementation changes instead of overwriting earlier reproducibility artifacts.
limitations: This attempt did not start training.
next_actions: Install the rank-parameterized overlay under a new filename and rerun in another experiment directory.
